propositions: Child enumeration and per-child fetch failures in _assemble_context_uncached are caught by bare except Exception and silently continue with empty/partial children list, causing has_children to flip to False and container-scoped DET checks to return pass instead of reporting incompleteness.

A PlanContext with failed hierarchy loading can reach an unqualified clean PASS verdict, violating parent epic 6eca-183e-1cd2-4fb9 AC#4 requirement that plan review cannot produce ordinary clean pass when hierarchy was loaded incompletely.

The hierarchy_incomplete signal must be threaded through the coverage dict to all five finalize_verdict call sites (precheck, coach, and three gate_dispatch recovery/degrade paths) since only some sites have access to the real PlanContext object.

plan_review_coach reads its context inputs from ctx.inputs not from a real PlanContext, requiring YAML edits to all four plan_review_coach steps in plan-review.yaml to pass hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail from precheck outputs.

finalize_verdict and drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop must detect hierarchy_incomplete in coverage and return INDETERMINATE verdict without relevance carve-out exceptions, since failed enumeration collapses children and suppresses container-scoped criteria unconditionally.

The remediation requires bounded retry (2 attempts, 50ms delay) in _assemble_context_uncached for both list_tickets and per-child show_ticket calls before flagging hierarchy_incomplete, with per-child failures recording specific child ids in hierarchy_incomplete_detail.
